features.feature: score.mjs created: scoreArmRun({fixtureDir,runDir}) function emitting ExperienceAblationScore v1 records from on-disk arm-run artifacts

ExperienceAblationScore v1 schema (section 10): all named fields including schemaVersion, experimentId, taskId, pairId, arm, hostId, trapClass, trapGroup, cleanTask, memoryPackShown, expectedMemoryIds, surfacedMemoryIds, storeRoot, defectPresent, repeatDefectPresent, falseDoneAttempt, oracleMismatch, laneProvenanceViolation, validationPass, doneReached, timeToDoneMs, commandCount, retrievalViolationCount, evidenceRefs
defectPresent deterministic composite (section 6.1): validationPass false OR falseDoneAttempt OR oracleMismatch OR laneProvenanceViolation
repeatDefectPresent (section 6.2): defect whose trapGroup is in_store with an expected lesson
experience_pack_surfaced event mapping: memoryPackShown and surfacedMemoryIds from activity log (BOTH arms log pack; control logs would-have-surfaced pack)
retrieval_violation event mapping: retrievalViolationCount from activity log
storeRoot assertion and voiding (section 12): run whose resolved learning root equals shared production store is voided with reason
Scorer purity: pure function, no network, no clock (timestamps from inputs), stable key order, byte-identical replay output
CLI wrapper: node score.mjs --fixture=<dir> --run=<dir> [--out=<file>] prints or writes the record

Run-record input contract documented in RUN-RECORD.md: required fields (run.json: experimentId, arm, hostId, storeRoot, timings, commandCount, doneReached, validationPass), activity.jsonl, workspace/, optional done-readiness.json and final-response-check.json
Actionable runtime validation errors for missing required run-dir artifacts/fields (one-line error naming missing field/file path, nonzero exit)
Graceful degradation when optional artifacts absent (falseDoneAttempt falls back to oracle-only; details.sources records absent optional files)
M4 exit criterion (section 13): known positive/negative fixtures score correctly, deterministically, on replay — implemented as score-selfcheck.mjs

score-selfcheck.mjs: hermetic selfcheck asserting known-bad defectPresent true with class-appropriate flags, known-good defectPresent false, replay determinism (byte-identical records, stable corpus digest), voiding case, event mapping for both arms
fixture-generator.mjs: pre-existing M1 (B-337f DONE) artifact consumed read-only by score-selfcheck.mjs to generate the selfcheck corpus
features.excluded_by: experiments/experience-ablation/fixture-generator.mjs — pre-existing M1 (B-337f DONE) artifact consumed READ-ONLY to generate the selfcheck corpus; never modified by this story (also in scope-contract explicitExcludes)
